why: search_semantic (repository.py:216-232) is the ANN -> symbolic re-rank pipeline: _ann_search at 234-257 returns (Fact, cosine similarity) from one query, _re_rank at 259-289 filters and boosts in memory, and line 232 returns ranked[:limit]. ContextProvider._get_relevant_facts_with_status (context_provider.py:171-178) calls it with the query embedding, and main.py:251 wires llm_client=cortex.llm_client into the bundle seam. TestSemanticSearchPipeline (tests/memory/test_semantic_search.py:68) covers the pipeline and its 14 tests pass. Advisory: semantic retrieval is reachable only through get_memory_context; get_relevant_facts stays lexical by explicit test (test_semantic_search.py:333-346), so a future direct caller of that public method silently bypasses ANN.

The candidate limit is 50 at repository.py:14; search_semantic passes it to _ann_search (line 230), whose SQL binds LIMIT $2 with that value (lines 252 and 255). The output limit defaults to 10 (interface line 119, implementation line 220) and the ranked list is sliced at line 232. test_ann_runs_with_50_candidates_and_returns_top_10 (test_semantic_search.py:82-100) asserts params == [VECTOR_LITERAL, 50], a single fetch, and len(results) == 10. Inherited caveat: ivfflat.probes=10 can still under-fill the pool for some query/volume distributions; that is the #31 setting and STD-3 requires consistency with #31, so it is not a #32 regression.

All three signals change which facts come out and in what order: FactType is a post-ANN filter (line 274), confidence is a post-ANN threshold (line 276) and a score term (line 285), recency is a 24h step boost (lines 279-284). That matches ADR-0008's 'FactType filter, confidence threshold, recency boost' and STD-4's filters-after-ANN contract. Tests: test_fact_type_filter_drops_wrong_type_after_ann:103, test_min_confidence_drops_low_confidence_candidate:127, test_recent_fact_outranks_old_fact_at_equal_similarity:139, test_high_confidence_fact_outranks_low_confidence_at_equal_similarity:157. FactType and the confidence floor are hard filters rather than reordering terms, which is how the ADR specifies them; the AC's 'affect final ranking' is satisfied through inclusion plus the confidence/recency score terms.

why: The embed + search_semantic block (context_provider.py:168-182) is inside a try/except; any pgvector/embedding error falls through to get_relevant_facts (lines 186-192), which calls FactRepository.search and therefore the ILIKE branch at repository.py:174-178. test_pgvector_failure_falls_back_to_lexical_and_degrades_facts (test_semantic_search.py:277-295) sets search_semantic.side_effect = RuntimeError('pgvector unavailable') and asserts repo.search is awaited with the query and the 0.4 default. _get_relevant_facts_with_status returns degraded=True when a configured LLM client fell back (line 193), and get_memory_context appends 'facts' at lines 75-76; there is no double append because an exception is caught once at 77-79. test_embedding_failure...:258, test_pgvector_failure...:277 and test_empty_semantic_pool...:297 assert bundle.degraded_dimensions == ['facts']; test_without_llm_client...:316 asserts no degradation when no client is configured. why: At 160ef89: uv run pytest tests/memory/test_semantic_search.py -q -> 14 passed; uv run pytest -q -> 1355 passed, 32 skipped (the skips are 4 docker-compose e2e tests and 28 evidence-engine #83 tests). ruff and mypy pass on the three changed source files. ADR-0008 lines 7-13 require top-50 ANN, symbolic re-ranking with FactType/confidence/recency, and ILIKE fallback through degraded_dimensions. The commit implements all three: _ANN_CANDIDATE_LIMIT = 50 (repository.py:14), _re_rank returning the top limit at line 232, and the fallback/degradation in context_provider.py:168-193 and 75-76. The ABC docstring records the 50-candidate contract (interfaces.py:126-128). No contradiction with ADR-0008, and no ADR edit is required because the ADR already describes this stage.

Layering holds: ContextProvider is the bundle seam (embedding plus degraded_dimensions), PostgresFactRepository owns ANN, filtering and scoring, and FactStore is untouched by this commit. The query embedding is the only new direct LLM call, as the class docstring at 27-28 now states, and main.py:251 wires the shared client. Advisory: the semantic path scores only by similarity, type/confidence filters and recency, so the session-id boost in _calculate_relevance_score (context_provider.py:207-209) no longer applies to facts returned by get_memory_context. ADR-0008's re-rank list and STD-4's formula exclude session relevance, so this is permitted, but it is a behavior change for the bundle seam.

search_semantic is on the FactRepository ABC with a complete docstring (interfaces.py:114-139). The implementation uses the same wire format as #31: _vector_literal is bound to $1::vector in both SELECT and ORDER BY (repository.py:248, 251) and SET ivfflat.probes = 10 (line 242) runs on the same DbSession connection before the fetch (line 243), matching search()'s existing handling at repository.py:199-200. ruff and mypy pass on the three changed source files.

The docstring states the contract and line 285 implements it as similarity + recency_boost + 0.1*confidence. Filters run after the single ANN fetch (lines 273-277), and search_semantic returns ranked[:limit] at line 232 without a second query. test_ann_runs...:82 asserts fetch is awaited once; test_semantic_path_embeds_query_and_skips_lexical:217 asserts the lexical repository is not queried when semantic returns facts. The only second query is the deliberate fallback, which runs after the semantic stage returns nothing or raises.
